subject: Post-reconnect instrument power readback
question: Can the bound host instrument slot establish power state when the editor has no Boolean value?

reverify.command: In the owned synthetic project, compare the exact Inspector instrument-slot bypass checkbox with the editor power control before and after a managed bridge restart. Exercise both bypass states with immediate independent native reads, preserve all 83 parameter rows, and compare active/bypassed/restored fixed-phrase bounces. Never infer state from a plain button or AXEnabled.
reverify.expected: The exact bound slot remains readable in both states; available editor values agree. Missing, mixed, contradictory or transport-failed observations refuse.
reverify.cost: Exclusive native GUI custody and a bounded disposable-project power roundtrip; no production project changes.

method: The aa3 candidate passed saved reopen and then refused a fresh read after managed bridge restart. Independent AX observation found the editor power as AXButton without AXValue (attributeUnsupported -25205), while the exact Inspector RetroSynth slot exposed its bypass checkbox. A native 0→1→0 roundtrip preserved all 83 parameter rows and restored the starting slot value; the editor remained an unvalued button in both states. The frozen b1710690 candidate subsequently passed a managed bridge restart with fresh instrument references and independent 83-row observations. The fixed-phrase active and restored bounces were nonzero. The bypass bounce was independently checked as exactly zero PCM; export_run correctly returned B near_silent_output, and that existing file was verified without retrying its export.

observations.what: Installed MCP reconnect and active/bypassed/restored render gate

restoration.limits: Exact silence under bypass; active/restored fixed-phrase comparison uses the same bounded gates as reopened renders. No deterministic PCM or general project claim.

conclusion: The exact physically bound instrument-slot bypass Boolean established power in both states after a managed reconnect. Readable editor values are corroborated. Active and restored audio passed the fixed-phrase gates; bypass PCM was exactly zero. Mixed or contradictory states and transport failures still refuse. This bounded power gate passes; complete release qualification is separate.
limits: Observed on one recorded Logic/macOS build and an owned two-track project.
The editor role change is recorded after the restart sequence; this does not establish its underlying platform cause.
The deliberately silent negative export remains B near_silent_output under the normal delivery safeguard. Independent zero-PCM verification is a qualification check, not a change to that safeguard.

canon_not_applicable.reason: This record describes API roles, status codes, numeric checkbox states, exact physical ownership and test postconditions. It introduces no translated label vocabulary or string-corpus claim.
